why_agent_cannot: enter an email and click the confirmation link
what_human_must_do: Enter your email and click the confirmation link in your inbox.
steps_from_source: Open the pre-registration page , enter your email and press "Send my code". You don't need a wallet or a password.
Type in the six-digit code from the email. It expires after ten minutes.
Copy your referral link if you want gems. A referral only pays once your friend reaches level 5 in the game.
Follow @BreathOfEstova for the launch day, which isn't published yet.
At launch, press "Enter Estova" on the site to collect the bundle.
